engine.summary: Numerical primitives: descriptive statistics and sample quantiles, normal, t, F and chi-squared distribution functions, parametric distributions with seeded sampling, Box-Cox, real FFT of any length, half-open interval sets and unit conversion.

surfaces.name: u-numflow
surfaces.error_shape: Err(...) of the module's error type where a function can refuse; statistics of too few values return None, and the bare distribution functions return NaN outside their domain.

surfaces.name: @iyulab/u-numflow
surfaces.note: Numbers arrays may be passed as number[] or Float64Array; arguments and results are typed in the .d.ts. Bundler and Node targets; no bundler-less browser build.
surfaces.error_shape: A thrown Error whose code property is the code, with the fields (parameter, index, min, max, exclusive_min, got, expected, ...) as its other properties.

surfaces.name: UNumflow
surfaces.note: C ABI wrapper over the same wire layer; versioned on its own axis, not with the crate.
surfaces.error_shape: A NumflowException whose ErrorCode is the code, Parameter and Index the fields of those names, and Details the rest.

errors.shape: A refusal carries a stable snake_case 'code' and the fields listed for that code; how it arrives depends on the surface (error_shape).

source.catalog: code_catalog in src/wire.rs, built from the Code table the refusals are made from; published as codes() in WebAssembly, unumflow_codes() over the C ABI and Codes on .NET. What each code means is tabled in README.md, which a test holds equal to the catalog.

operations.summary: The arithmetic mean of a non-empty sample (Kahan compensated summation).

The sample variance (denominator n - 1) of two or more values.
The median of a non-empty sample; an even count gives the mean of the middle two.
Sample quantiles at each probability in [0, 1], in the order asked, by R-7 linear interpolation (Hyndman & Fan 1996; the default of R, NumPy and Excel).

operations.summary: n variates of a parametric distribution, reproducible from the seed: the same (distribution, n, seed) always gives the same values. The distribution is {kind, ...parameters}: uniform, triangular, pert, normal, lognormal, weibull, exponential, gamma, beta or chi_squared.

operations.summary: A list of half-open [start, end] intervals in normal form: sorted, disjoint, touching pieces merged, empty ones dropped; a reversed interval is refused, not swapped.
The total length of the union of half-open intervals; a point covered by several counts once.
The points in a or b, as intervals in normal form.
The points in both a and b, as intervals in normal form; clipping to a window is the intersection with [[from, to]].
The points in a but not in b, as intervals in normal form.
A reading in one unit expressed in another (20 Cel is 293.15 K): UCUM-style expressions over the SI units and the caller's own definitions; units of different dimensions are refused.

performance.complexity: Linear in the length of the two expressions and the definitions.

operations.summary: An amount of change in one unit expressed in another: the offset of a scale cancels, so a rise of 20 Cel is a rise of 20 K.

performance.complexity: Linear in the length of the two expressions and the definitions.

operations.summary: What a unit expression stands for: its dimension in SI base units (with the seven exponents), and the scale and offset that take a value to SI.

performance.complexity: Linear in the length of the expression and the definitions.
